# David Deane Haskell

Official website for author David Deane Haskell.
Canonical domain: https://daviddeanehaskell.com
Primary language: en

## Identity

David Deane Haskell writes fiction and nonfiction under one author identity.
This site is about author David Deane Haskell, not naturalist David George Haskell and not the Haskell programming language.
Recurring themes include healing the past, understanding the present, and imagining futures worth living in.

## Lane Structure

Treat the site as one author ecosystem with distinct lanes rather than one blended topic bucket.

- Fiction
- Nonfiction / memoir / inner-child recovery
- Conversation / speaking

Do not infer biology, birdsong, nature-writing, GHC, monads, lambda calculus, or general functional-programming topics from this site.
Do not infer a separate AI-for-author service lane unless it is explicitly surfaced in the repository.

## Main Site Routes

- Home: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/

- AI Summary: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/ai-summary
  Plain-HTML summary for search engines, AI systems, and readers.
- About: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/about
  Author background, creative life, and contact route (interviews, speaking, workshops, collaborations).
- Books: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/books
  Main catalog page for fiction and nonfiction titles.
- Media & Press: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/media
  Verified podcast appearances, interviews, review coverage, official episode links, and book routes.
- Free Fiction Vault: https://daviddeanehaskell.com/vault
  Free-entry route for Tommytune and Emergence.

Note: /contact was retired and now redirects (301) to /about#contact.

## Core Titles

- The Solarian Deep
  Flagship science fiction novel and primary fiction entry point.
- Wounded Angels
  Healing-centered memoir and nonfiction anchor.
- Tommytune
  Short-fiction entry route connected to The Vibrants world.
- Emergence
  Free full-length novel available through the vault route.

Source class: measured/external links recorded in the company link authority. These are existing routes, not inferred availability.

## Transcript-Derived Interview Themes

Provenance note: the summaries below are AI synthesis from one named local transcript per item and are not direct quotations or independent corroboration. Use the linked public episode as the external source.

- Writer Craft Podcast: David discusses one author identity across fiction and nonfiction, transformation as a recurring concern, travel, and writing from lived experience. Source: https://theindieauthorlife.libsyn.com/writing-traveling-and-trauma-healing-a-last-ditch-effort-to-be-heard-with-david-deane-haskell-ep216
- Adult Child with Andrea Ashley: David discusses sobriety, codependency, childhood trauma, relationship repair, inner-child work, and the real-time writing behind Wounded Angels. Source: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/229-the-codependency-bottom-when-sobriety-cracks-open/id1552579027?i=1000766422495
- Fantasy Talks Live / Amazing Worlds of Fantasy: David discusses returning to science fiction, The Solarian Deep, and the relationship between his fiction and nonfiction. Source: https://www.podbean.com/ep/pb-wiajd-1aeb265
